So the player's W moved from the left column to the top row?? That's a rotation! And the square's frame changed from c to G.
Wait, that doesn't make sense either. Let me think about what UP did. Actually, maybe the player's "W" part indicates facing direction or a highlight. Hmm.
Alternative: maybe the player is 4x4, and the W part indicates the side facing the item? In the first pickup (step 4), the player was at rows 40-43, cols 32-35: W at row 40 (top row), N at rows 41-43. The item was above. After SPACE, the item was carried.
